detaileddescription.para: Runs on the JUCE message thread.

Owns the model, the engine context (Processor), the stdout writer, and the stdin reader. The message thread writes stdout and makes no engine call. Processor owns the engine context. The reader thread calls Processor::addRequest through onMessage.
Members are destroyed in reverse declaration order, so the reader is destroyed before the processor.
